title: CIBA (backchannel)
lede: CIBA backchannel sign-in: the user approves on a mock phone while the BFF polls. Mock only.

nodes.label: BFF
sub: Holds the PKCE verifier and the session-token cookie. In this lab the page plays this part.

nodes.label: Mock PingOne
sub: Issues flows, codes and mock tokens. Not a real tenant.

nodes.label: Resource server
sub: Mock. Demands acr mock:multi for a transfer.

nodes.label: Mock phone
sub: Stands in for the user's device (CIBA).

steps.title: Start the request
steps.what: POST /bc-authorize with login_hint and a binding_message of at most 8 characters (mock limit). The answer carries auth_req_id and an interval.

steps.title: Notify the phone
steps.what: The mock pushes a notification to the user's phone, showing the binding message.

steps.title: The user answers
steps.what: The user taps Approve or Deny on the mock phone (POST /phone/approve or /phone/deny).

steps.title: Poll for the answer
steps.what: The BFF polls POST /token with the CIBA grant. Until the user answers: authorization_pending. Too fast: slow_down. After denial: access_denied. After the deadline: expired_token.

steps.title: Tokens once approved
steps.what: Once approved, the poll returns the tokens.

steps.title: Signed in
steps.what: The BFF tells the browser the user is signed in. The browser never saw the approval.
